name: Rockland to Carver's Harbor
note: Threads the ledges around Old Harbor, The Reach, and Green Island Knob into Carver's Harbor on Vinalhaven. Verified live 2026-09-12 as a hand-built route after direct AutoRoute fell back to a straight line on this corridor — kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.

name: Rockland to Warren Island
note: Runs up West Penobscot Bay past Camden and Lincolnville, then curves around Warren Island's north end into the state park's mooring field. Verified live 2026-09-17 — AutoRoute threads this corridor cleanly; kept here as both a sample route and a regression check for the router.
